title: A session effect took any timeline failure with a refusal's code as a refusal, so a store conflict after the timeline wrote committed a partial application as evidence
resolution: The bound timeline's stores are watched; a failure is a refusal only when no store call failed and none wrote, else it is returned, as internal for a refusal's code, and rolls back. Unit tests and a Postgres test of items.add conflict; design and spec corrected.

title: No test failed when only the protocol rejection of an offer went back to the worker's window, because its tests used a window of 3 to 4
resolution: A protocol rejection with a window of 2 to 3 checks that the assignment is refused and the worker gets version 2; it alone fails when that call site uses the window of version 1 (mutation control recorded).

title: The log requirement gave every session evidence log the same fields, but the epoch gate logs its epochs and quarantine state, and an ownership refusal has no code
resolution: The requirement names the fields of an ownership refusal, of a timeline refusal, which alone has the code, and of the epoch gate, with a scenario; the design's log section follows.

title: Two comments and the design said every deferred message of items 21 and 38 is quarantined as unknown, but a version 2 command passes at a version 1 worker for it to reject
resolution: Both comments and design decision Q9 state the distinction between the observations and the version 2 commands; a transport test and a spec scenario pin it, with a mutation control.

title: The watch wrapped every member of the timeline transaction in a proxy, so reading a member that is no object, such as the Postgres transaction's boolean changed, would throw
resolution: Only an object member is wrapped; any other is returned as it is. A unit test reads a boolean member and a missing one through the watch and fails when every member is wrapped.

title: The watch told reads from writes by a set of bare call names shared by all stores and unchecked against the port interfaces, so a renamed or new read would silently turn refusals into failures
resolution: A table names each call of each store as a read or a write and the compiler checks it against SessionTimelineTransaction, so a missing or unknown call does not compile; an unnamed call still counts as a write at run time.

title: In turnEnded a local named failure shadowed the failure constructor of the kernel that the same file uses
The proposal still said a deferred message of items 21 and 38 is quarantined as unknown, gave the refusal rule without the untouched stores condition, and left the watch file out of Impact
resolution: The proposal states the distinction of design decision Q9, the condition that the stores are untouched, and names the new file under Impact.

title: The design named one domain call after a write, but appendOutput also calls the domain after it wrote the held tail
resolution: The design names both calls, the change applied again after the tail is cleared and the output appended after the tail is written, and why neither can refuse.

title: The list of payload fields the effects ignore left out the cause of an ended generation and the reason of an acceptance unknown report
resolution: Both are added to the design's risks and to the limitations of the verification record.

title: The requirement and its scenario said the tables and the four deferred messages cover every message of the channels, though the command subject notices and the inventory report are in no table
resolution: The requirement excepts the command subject notices and the inventory report, which have their own schemas, and the scenario lists them.
